estimates.assumptions: 4 medium carrots (approx 500g total), raw, peeled and sliced; standard carrot values ~9.6g carbs/100g and ~2.8g fiber/100g
1/2 medium red cabbage (approx 500g), raw and shredded; standard red cabbage values ~6.6g carbs/100g and ~2.8g fiber/100g
2 medium red onions (approx 220g total), raw and sliced; standard red onion values ~6.4g carbs/100g and ~1.2g fiber/100g
small handful fresh mint leaves (approx 10g); standard mint values ~15g carbs/100g with most as fiber
small handful fresh coriander leaves (approx 10g); standard coriander values ~4g carbs/100g with most as fiber
small handful roasted peanuts (approx 30g); standard roasted peanut values ~16g carbs/100g and ~7g fiber/100g (unsalted)
juice of 2 limes (approx 60ml total); standard lime juice values ~11g carbs/100ml, negligible fiber
1 tablespoon groundnut oil (15ml); standard peanut oil values 0g carbs and fiber
1 red chilli (approx 20g), chopped; standard fresh red chilli values ~9g carbs/100g, negligible fiber
1 tablespoon brown sugar (12g); standard brown sugar values ~100g carbs/100g, negligible fiber
